column3: the servicer, in response to a request made by an obligor, provides for extensions or deferrals of payment with respect to a receivable to the extent that the following conditions all apply: (A) such extensions or deferrals may not extend the final payment more than five (5) months past the original final payment date; (B) such extensions or deferrals will not exceed five (5) months in the aggregate during the life of such receivable; and (C) such extension or deferral does not cause the number of extensions or months by which the payment due date relating to such loan to be extended in the aggregate more than one (1) month within a continuous 12-month period; or
